scope: Targeted primary-source reading for a proposed sectional beta moment collision repair and continuous-mass stochastic alternatives. Seven selected studies; not an exhaustive survey.
evidence_state: Published numerical method lineage and source-scoped findings, followed by an explicitly proposed sectional adaptation. No new calculation, convergence result or empirical validation is established by this ledger.
external_bytes: No full papers or external datasets added to the repository. Web/PDF extraction was read without retaining local byte identities; no source-file hashes are claimed.

sources.authors: C. Yuan, F. Laurent and R. O. Fox
sources.title: An extended quadrature method of moments for population balance equations
sources.reading_extent: Publisher-indexed abstract, introduction and method passages on positive kernel mixtures, source-term quadrature and beta/gamma lineage. Full paper not read.
sources.retrieval_limits: Direct ScienceDirect retrieval failed; HAL document and record returned Anubis access denial. The indexed publisher excerpts are the admitted evidence, not a substitute full-paper reading.
sources.use: EQMOM lineage for population balances and independent secondary-quadrature refinement.
sources.limit: Does not establish the proposed per-cell single-beta aggregation discretization or its narrow-tail accuracy.

sources.retrieval_limits: Direct publisher requests returned errors/403; method claims are restricted to retrieved indexed passages.

sources.limit: No source-specific implementation or published convergence dataset was reproduced.

sources.authors: V. Vikas, C. D. Hauck, Z. J. Wang and R. O. Fox
sources.title: Radiation transport modeling using extended quadrature method of moments
sources.reading_extent: Author-hosted published PDF text: abstract, introduction, §§3.1–3.2.4 and opening of §4. Read beta parameterization, atomic limits, inversion failure discussion and secondary quadrature. Numerical benchmark sections and figure images not substantively reviewed.
sources.retrieval_limits: PDF text retrieved successfully; no local source-byte hash retained.
sources.evidence: Primary numerical-method implementation in radiation transport.
sources.use: Positive beta reconstruction, degeneration to atomic measures and moment-preserving Gauss–Jacobi quadrature.
sources.limit: Radiation-transport tests do not validate snow collisions. General multi-component inversion can fail to reproduce its highest moment; that fallback is not admitted for the proposed width-preserving repair.

sources.authors: S. Shima, K. Kusano, A. Kawano, T. Sugiyama and S. Kawahara
sources.title: The super-droplet method for the numerical simulation of clouds and precipitation: a particle-based and probabilistic microphysics model coupled with a non-hydrostatic model
sources.publication: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society 135, 1307–1320 (2009)
sources.version: Author-deposited peer-reviewed text, arXiv physics/0701103 v2 (2022-07-30).
sources.reading_extent: Full HTML available; inspected §§4.1.1–4.1.4, 5.1.3 and opening of 5.1.4, including multiplicity updates, expectation/variance derivation, random-pair sampling and multiple-collision shortcut. Remaining sections not fully read.
sources.retrieval_limits: Author HTML retrieved successfully; no source-byte hash retained.
sources.evidence: Primary formulation of the superdroplet method.
sources.use: Distinguish unbiased expected counts from packet-amplified count variance; require small-probability controls.
sources.limit: Neither equal packet weights nor the high-probability multiple-collision shortcut establishes physical collector variance.

sources.authors: X.-Y. Li, B. Mehlig, G. Svensson, A. Brandenburg and N. E. L. Haugen
sources.title: Collision Fluctuations of Lucky Droplets with Superdroplets
sources.reading_extent: Author-hosted published PDF text: abstract, introduction, §2 algorithm, §3 approaches and inspected §4 comparisons, multiplicity/depletion tests and collector-interaction discussion. Appendix B result encountered through its main-text description; appendix and figure images not independently reviewed.
sources.retrieval_limits: Direct publisher request returned 403; full PDF text retrieved from coauthor site.
sources.evidence: Primary simulation comparison of lucky-droplet growth-time distributions.
sources.use: Separate tagged-collector variability from global population-count variability; recognize successful weighted tests under declared conditions.
sources.limit: Warm liquid droplets, idealized efficiencies, all-pair evaluation and small collision probabilities; not direct validation of random-pair lunar snow calculations.

sources.title: Stochastic coalescence in Lagrangian cloud microphysics
sources.reading_extent: Publisher PDF text: abstract, introduction, algorithm discussion, §§3–4, selected §5 finite-volume discussion and relevant conclusions. Figure captions and reported fluctuation scaling read; plots not visually inspected or digitized.
sources.retrieval_limits: Publisher PDF retrieved successfully; XML request failed. No source-byte hash retained.
sources.evidence: Primary superdroplet comparisons with master-equation/SSA and published direct-simulation results.
sources.use: Multiplicity-dependent fluctuation floors and sensitivity to finite volume and mixing assumptions.
sources.limit: Reported multiplicity and mixing-volume thresholds belong to the tested warm-cloud conditions and are not universal lunar criteria.

local_derivations: Single beta parameters from cell number, mean and variance; bounded-support realizability and atomic boundary cases.
Binary-coagulation moment increment (-1, 0, 2*m*m_prime) and destination-cell weak form.
Variance of floor(p)+Bernoulli(frac(p)) differs from Poisson p; consequence derived directly from Shima's stated rule.
method_status: Candidate sectional adaptation; implementation and numerical evidence are recorded separately. No artificial width or diffusion term is justified by these sources.
